Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art fighter SPRITE ATLAS for Sandbox Wars, a cyberpunk street-fighting game. Make one ORIGINAL human character, unofficial provider-inspired concept. STYLE: high-quality 16-bit arcade pixel art, sharp square pixel clusters, stepped dark contours, restricted shading ramps. No painterly blur, no smooth vector cartoon, no 3D render.
LAYOUT: square PNG, true transparent background, EXACTLY nine images in a strict 3x3 grid of equal square cells. No text, labels, grid lines, background, floor or cast shadow. Each figure must fit INSIDE its cell with 7% transparent margin on ALL edges, including top and bottom. Figures never touch across cells. All full-body sprites face RIGHT in three-quarter view. Same body scale across six idle frames and standing victory, boots at same baseline, max height 80% of cell. Rows one and two contain six subtly differing CLEAN idle frames of identical character. Bottom left battered defeat, bottom middle battered victory, bottom right enlarged clean head-and-shoulders portrait of same character. Portrait contained in its cell. Maintain identical clothes, proportions, colors and face across all nine. Damage only in bottom-left and bottom-middle; no blood or gore. Gear stays attached, no detached props or particles.
CHARACTER: AWS / AMAZON, cyberpunk warehouse FINAL BOSS. Towering square-built older human man, shaved head, short graying beard, stern broad face. Dark NAVY rigid industrial vest over CHARCOAL short-sleeve shirt, armored cargo trousers, enormous black work boots. One arm wears an oversized mechanical lifting glove extending over forearm, dark steel with AMBER work lights. The other wrist has a compact barcode scanner. Orange SMILE-SHAPED seam stitched across vest, subtle orange straps. Mostly dark navy/charcoal with small amber highlights, NOT orange dominant. Massive squared shoulders and mechanical glove are defining silhouette. Human heavy logistics enforcer, not robot, no sailor clothes, no blue beanie, no whale tattoo, no flame hair. Exposed natural arm dark brown skin with scars, rugged face.
IDLE six frames: wide stance, natural hand slowly tightens mechanical glove strap, neck shifts slightly, minimal imposing movement. Feet planted, six subtle variations, no punching.
BOTTOM LEFT BATTERED DEFEAT: seated heavily on ground, mechanical glove bent and hanging open while still attached, slumped shoulders, scuffed vest and small cheek bandage, looking deeply offended.
BOTTOM CENTER BATTERED VICTORY: standing exhausted, damaged mechanical arm hangs down, raises opposite wrist scanner and looks at its screen as if confirming a completed delivery, weary businesslike expression. Same cheek bandage and scuffs.
BOTTOM RIGHT PORTRAIT: clean head and shoulders, bald graying bearded dark-skinned enforcer, navy vest, amber collar light, no injuries.
Same adult character throughout. High readability at small size, no text.

CHARACTER: GOOGLE CLOUD / GCP, an unthreatening corporate research SCIENTIST who brought proprietary equipment to a street fight. Middle-aged human man, narrow build with slight belly and stiff awkward posture, receding brown hairline, thick round glasses, clean-shaven thoughtful face. WHITE knee-length lab coat over BLUE button-down shirt, dark gray sensible trousers, boring brown shoes, clipped employee photo badge without readable writing. One arm carries an enormous experimental gauntlet: BLUE main housing, RED upper panel, YELLOW round joint, GREEN forearm section, small status LEDs. Four Google colors in large purposeful panel blocks, not rainbow sprinkles. Other arm ordinary, gauntlet asymmetry essential. Cyberpunk experimental circuitry and cables attached to glove. No athletic physique, no capoeira, no ninja, no tracksuit, no futuristic helmet. The joke is huge engineering equipment on a very ordinary scientist.
IDLE six frames: awkward feet-planted stance; normal hand taps gauntlet controls, pauses waiting, briefly adjusts glasses. Minimal subtle changes, same gauntlet structure and costume across six frames, no large steps or attacks.
BOTTOM LEFT BATTERED DEFEAT: sitting slumped with giant gauntlet still attached resting on ground beside him, casing cracked, staring in disbelief at malfunctioning equipment, glasses crooked, torn coat hem, cheek bandage. No sparks or detached debris.
BOTTOM CENTER BATTERED VICTORY: standing tired, small cracked tablet mounted on oversized gauntlet, takes notes on it with normal hand, lanyard badge askew, glasses crooked, small cheek bandage, coat scuffed. Human ordinary scientist proud of experiment.
BOTTOM RIGHT PORTRAIT: clean face with receding hairline, thick round glasses, white coat, blue collar and badge, a little colorful gauntlet shoulder-side visible. No injuries.
White coat dominates silhouette; colorful glove obvious and large but stays inside padded cell.

CHARACTER: EXE.DEV, a compact human adult street punk wearing an absurdly intimidating PUFFERFISH HELMET. Short stocky torso, thin short legs, oversized round helmet, heavy black boots. Helmet inspired by natural beige pufferfish: warm CREAM and SAND upper shell with dark brown speckles, pale belly, stubby brown-tipped spikes, small side fins attached, comically angry dark fish eyes. Small human eyes visible through mouth-shaped opening at helmet front. Handmade futuristic inflatable motorcycle helmet, obvious headgear worn by a human, NOT an actual fish creature. Cropped BLACK leather biker jacket with cream piping, patched charcoal trousers, fingerless gloves. Tiny amber air-pressure gauge on collar and short air hose attached to jacket. No bright green, blue, orange armor; muted cream/brown helmet against black outfit. Face mostly hidden in clean frames.
IDLE six frames: tiny gloved fists raised with excessive confidence, feet planted, helmet subtly expands and relaxes across six frames, spikes remain short and attached. Keep inflation SMALL and within padded cell; body/boots constant size. Very funny round head versus narrow little legs, genuine sharp pixel art.
BOTTOM LEFT BATTERED DEFEAT: sits slumped on ground, puffer helmet visibly deflated and dented, rubber spikes drooping, mouth opening stretched to expose irritated young adult human face, black jacket scuffed, small cheek adhesive bandage. No gore.
BOTTOM CENTER BATTERED VICTORY: standing with fully inflated round puffer helmet and stubby spikes upright, tiny folded arms underneath, disproportionately smug fish expression; shell patched with two small strips of tape, boots and jacket scuffed. Inflation still fits cell with generous margin, body same scale as idle.
BOTTOM RIGHT PORTRAIT: clean close-up cream speckled pufferfish helmet, angry cute eyes, short spines, human eyes peeking from mouth opening, black jacket shoulders. No injuries, no tape. 
All nine portray same helmet, same human, same clothes. Use original natural pufferfish palette from exe.dev's small cream/tan fish mark on its black site. No text or logo words.
